name: Authentication, Encryption, Diagnostics, Packaging, Recovery
transaction_boundaries: Password setup/change/reset, auto-login enable/disable and security settings use one LLD-01 UnitOfWork with command receipt and action-specific audit; credential material is never placed in audit payload.
Session creation/validation and run-control authentication are bounded in-memory/process security state and do not create domain authority.
Live DEK generation/protection occurs before opening a new authoritative database; database access requires successful DPAPI unwrap and SQLCipher key verification before migration/readiness.

Portable backup creation snapshots authoritative state first, then encrypts outside the writer transaction; payload.somabackup, manifest.json and auth.json are built and verified under one same-parent temporary .somabackupset directory and only the verified directory is atomically published.

Restore decrypts and verifies into an isolated staging root before acquiring replacement authority; portable restore additionally requires the complete detached manifest/auth set and valid complete-set fingerprint before any live authoritative mutation.
Diagnostic emission is external/non-authoritative and fail-open only for its own loss after prevention/sanitization; it never changes authoritative success/failure.
failure_modes: authentication mismatch or malformed verifier fails closed without credential detail
DPAPI unwrap/protect failure blocks protected-data readiness and never falls back to plaintext
wrong SQLCipher key/cipher mismatch/integrity failure blocks startup before migrations
invalid Host/Origin/session/CSRF/run-auth/replay fails before command dispatch
forged/stale runtime registry, PID/port reuse or redirect fails trusted-instance verification

portable backup missing/extra companions, detached-auth mismatch, payload digest mismatch, wrong recovery secret, tamper, truncation, unsupported format or schema failure is non-mutating and cannot publish/restore a partial set
diagnostic sanitizer uncertainty omits field/record; raw fallback forbidden
packaging/runtime dependency verification failure blocks release/readiness rather than downloading code at runtime

implementation_gate.construction_integrity_result: historical pre-hardened integrity result; superseded for current readiness by the evidence-normalized full review-ready gate

review_evidence: Security authorities are separated across password verifier, live DEK, portable-backup recovery, run-control identity and excluded future device credentials.
Argon2id/DPAPI/SQLCipher/AEAD choices are pinned at LLD layer rather than retroactively asserted by HLD/Architecture.

LLD-01 SQLCipher connection-factory/provider reconciliation and LLD-10 authentication/deliberate-action consumer signatures are closed in the canonical cross-packet interface layer and enforced by SIG-008.

The Local User Profile seam is reconciled: LLD-02 persists stable profile/actor identity plus editable descriptive display_name only; setup/login require no username, first-run supplies the server-side Local Administrator default, and display-name edits do not mutate LLD-12 credential/session/security/encryption authority.
Browser session+CSRF and launcher run-control are separate credentials; neither is encoded in URL/browser history.

Portable backup is governed SOMA_PORTABLE_BACKUP_SET_V1: payload.somabackup plus canonical detached manifest.json plus HMAC-SHA-256 auth.json, with KEK/auth-key HKDF domain separation and atomic directory publication; payload alone is never a complete portable backup.

Portable restore is verify-before-mutation and rejects incomplete/unauthenticated companion sets before preview success or live quiesce; managed backup rotation cannot remove the last verified restorable copy.

Pass 1 independently re-reviewed the corrected semantic source and closed cross-packet, chronology, portable-backup, profile-identity and reverse-traceability findings with all hardened gates at zero.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 2 independently re-reviewed the corrected source and passed with strengthened contract-reference, internal-command and durable-job closure at zero.
Packaging is offline at runtime, per-user by default, and uninstall preserves data/backups unless an explicit separately confirmed data-removal workflow is invoked.
Final package dependency hashes and release-signing identity remain release-candidate freeze evidence; they do not reopen Beta 1.0 LLD design or block implementation readiness.
pending_global_reconciliation: final package dependency hashes/release signing identity at release-candidate freeze
design_principle: Local convenience never collapses trust boundaries: Windows may protect installation secrets, the SOMA password authenticates the operator, Local User Profile display_name is descriptive only, portable recovery protects backups, and every browser/launcher request remains untrusted until its own exact security context validates.
